intermediate.name: San Martino in Grania
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (4) San Martino in Grania (147 km)
Red Bull KM Sprint | Colle Pinzuto (167.1 km)

story: Four riders attacked immediately after the start, with two more soon joining to form a six-man breakaway. After the first sterrato sector, only Groves and Hermans remained out front, while maglia rosa Ulissi was distanced in the peloton. The last escapees were caught before a new five-man group formed. Del Toro accelerated from this move and only Van Aert could follow. The duo stayed clear to the finish, where Van Aert took the lead just before the final corner and used that position to win the sprint, while Del Toro claimed the maglia rosa.
